description: This file defines a React functional component named OrderTrackingStepper, which displays a horizontal step indicator for tracking the status of an order. It manages internal state, interacts with notification context, and renders UI elements dynamically based on order status. It also allows advancing the order status interactively in mock/demo modes.

methods.name: OrderTrackingStepper({ orderId, status: externalStatus, onAdvance })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a step indicator for order status, with optional controls to advance status and send notifications.

methods.name: advanceStatus
methods.description: Function to advance the order status to the next step, update internal state if in mock mode, invoke callback, and trigger notification.
